verdict.rationale: Jev/TypeSafe is a request/response 'ask a typed question, get a typed answer' API — patterns like confidence-routing and intent-routing (jev-docs-10, jev-docs-25) explicitly rely on the developer's own code to decide and act on the answer, not on Jev defining or executing rules/triggers itself. No evidence shows a rule-definition interface or an event-trigger/action-execution engine; automation is always delegated to the caller's code.
